clinicalHistory: Excision of a suspicious pigmented lesion on the left forearm for histological assessment.
comparisonWithPrevious: No previous biopsy of this lesion.
macroscopicDescription: Ellipse of skin measuring 20 x 10mm with a central 4mm pigmented macule. Margins inked.
microscopicDescription: Sections show a benign compound melanocytic naevus with no cytological atypia, no mitotic activity, and no evidence of malignancy. Excision margins clear.
diagnosis: Benign compound melanocytic naevus, completely excised.
impression: Benign melanocytic naevus; no further action required.
recommendedFollowUp: No further follow-up required for this benign lesion.
